meta_description: OpenDrone ships on Betaflight, AM32 and ExpressLRS. Incutec forwards €1 of every board sold to the upstream maintainers. Here is the list.
title: The firmware makes the hardware fly. *We pay the people who wrote it.*
lead: Every OpenDrone board runs on community firmware the project didn't write. For every board sold, Incutec forwards €1 to the upstream project: one contribution, one transaction, one line item in the books. Here's the list, with links if you want to give them more directly.
s1_body: When you buy a board, the checkout total covers the hardware price plus a €1 firmware contribution baked in. We batch those contributions and forward them to the upstream project via GitHub Sponsors, OpenCollective, or a direct bank transfer, depending on what the maintainers have set up.
Buy a stack (an OpenFC-Lite and an OpenESC in one order) and the split doubles: €1 to Betaflight, €1 to AM32. Every board carries its own contribution, so both maintainers keep their cut.
partner_betaflight_blurb: Betaflight is the flight controller firmware used in most mini-quad freestyle builds. OpenFC-Lite is a Betaflight-target board; the RP2354 target work is developed on a public fork and has not been submitted upstream yet.
partner_am32_blurb: AM32 is a multi-MCU ESC firmware alternative to BLHeli, GPL-3.0 licensed. OpenESC runs AM32 on AT32F421 channels: the same firmware as other AM32 ESCs, no custom fork, no vendor lock-in.
partner_expresslrs_blurb: ExpressLRS is the open long-range 2.4 GHz / sub-GHz radio protocol. OpenRX targets are upstream (Unified_ESP32C3_2400_RX for Lite, Unified_ESP32C3_LR1121_RX for Mono/Gemini) so you flash with the standard ExpressLRS configurator.
s3_body: Want to give the maintainers more than the baked-in €1? Where a project runs a public donation page, its card above links to it; AM32 has none, so its share is forwarded by direct transfer. Giving directly means no payment-processor fee: 100% of what you send reaches them.
s4_body: Money is one half; patches are the other. These are our changes that upstream actually merged: every link goes to the real PR.
